docs.title: About pd-biomarker-model

docs.title: Parkinson's disease biomarker model
docs.text:
Parkinson's disease module of the clinical biomarker core. It narrows diagnoses to parkinsonian disorders, binds clinical assessments to MDS-UPDRS, MoCA and Hoehn and Yahr, and adds instrument-specific validation rules.

URI: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model

Name: pd_biomarker_model

docs.text:
name: BiomarkerMeasurement
description: One biomarker value for one analyte at one visit, from a specimen (fluid
  or tissue) or from imaging.
from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
is_a: NamedThing
mixins:
- ProvenanceMixin
attributes:
  visit:
    name: visit
    description: The visit at which this record was collected.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - PhenotypeObservation
    - ClinicalAssessment
    - Specimen
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: Visit
    required: true
  specimen:
    name: specimen
    description: The specimen that was assayed. Absent for imaging measurements.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: Specimen
  assay:
    name: assay
    description: The assay that produced the value.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: Assay
    required: true
  analyte:
    name: analyte
    description: The analyte that was measured.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: Analyte
    required: true
  platform_probe_id:
    name: platform_probe_id
    description: 'Platform-specific reagent identifier: a SomaScan SeqId (e.g. seq.12345.6)
      or an Olink assay ID (e.g. OID12345).'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: string
    pattern: ^(seq\.[0-9]{4,5}\.[0-9]{1,3}|OID[0-9]{5})$
  loinc_code:
    name: loinc_code
    description: LOINC code of the laboratory test, where one exists.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: uriorcurie
    pattern: ^LOINC:[0-9]{1,7}-[0-9]$
  modality:
    name: modality
    description: Whether the value comes from a specimen or from imaging.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: ModalityEnum
    required: true
  measurement_type:
    name: measurement_type
    description: Kind of quantity the value represents.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: MeasurementTypeEnum
    required: true
  value:
    name: value
    description: Numeric value of a quantitative measurement.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: float
  unit:
    name: unit
    description: Unit of the value, as a UCUM code.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: UnitEnum
  categorical_result:
    name: categorical_result
    description: Result of a qualitative assay.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: CategoricalResultEnum
  below_lloq:
    name: below_lloq
    description: True when the value is below the assay's lower limit of quantification.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: boolean
  brain_region:
    name: brain_region
    description: Brain region of an imaging measurement, as an UBERON term.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: BrainRegionEnum
  laterality:
    name: laterality
    description: Side of the body the imaging value refers to.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - BiomarkerMeasurement
    range: LateralityEnum
  source:
    name: source
    description: Identifier or name of the source dataset, file or system the record
      was taken from.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: prov:hadPrimarySource
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - ProvenanceMixin
    range: string
    required: true
  curation_date:
    name: curation_date
    description: Date the record was curated.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: prov:generatedAtTime
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - ProvenanceMixin
    range: date
    required: true
  curator:
    name: curator
    description: 'Who curated the record: an ORCID for a person, or a versioned agent
      identifier for an AI agent.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: prov:wasAttributedTo
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - ProvenanceMixin
    range: uriorcurie
    required: true
  curator_type:
    name: curator_type
    description: Whether the curator was a person or an AI agent.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - ProvenanceMixin
    range: CuratorTypeEnum
    required: true
  id:
    name: id
    description: Globally unique identifier of the record, written as a CURIE.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:identifier
    identifier: true
    owner: BiomarkerMeasurement
    domain_of:
    - NamedThing
    range: uriorcurie
    required: true
    pattern: ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$
rules:
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      measurement_type:
        name: measurement_type
        equals_string: RATIO
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      unit:
        name: unit
        equals_string: '1'
  description: A ratio is dimensionless, so its unit must be the UCUM unity "1".
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      measurement_type:
        name: measurement_type
        equals_string: CONCENTRATION
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      unit:
        name: unit
        equals_string_in:
        - pg/mL
        - ng/mL
  description: A concentration must use a mass-concentration unit.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      measurement_type:
        name: measurement_type
        equals_string: RELATIVE_ABUNDANCE
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      unit:
        name: unit
        equals_string_in:
        - '{RFU}'
        - '{NPX}'
  description: A relative abundance must use a platform-relative unit (SomaScan RFU
    or Olink NPX), never a mass concentration.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      measurement_type:
        name: measurement_type
        equals_string_in:
        - CONCENTRATION
        - RELATIVE_ABUNDANCE
        - RATIO
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      value:
        name: value
        required: true
      unit:
        name: unit
        required: true
  description: A quantitative measurement needs a numeric value and a unit.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      measurement_type:
        name: measurement_type
        equals_string: CATEGORICAL
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      categorical_result:
        name: categorical_result
        required: true
      value:
        name: value
        value_presence: ABSENT
  description: A categorical measurement needs a categorical result and must not carry
    a numeric value.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      measurement_type:
        name: measurement_type
        equals_string: CATEGORICAL
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      unit:
        name: unit
        value_presence: ABSENT
  description: A categorical measurement must not carry a unit.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      modality:
        name: modality
        equals_string: IMAGING
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      brain_region:
        name: brain_region
        required: true
      laterality:
        name: laterality
        required: true
      specimen:
        name: specimen
        value_presence: ABSENT
  description: An imaging measurement needs a brain region and laterality and has
    no specimen.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      modality:
        name: modality
        equals_string: SPECIMEN
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      specimen:
        name: specimen
        required: true
      brain_region:
        name: brain_region
        value_presence: ABSENT
  description: A specimen-based measurement needs a specimen and has no brain region.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      curator_type:
        name: curator_type
        equals_string: PERSON
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      curator:
        name: curator
        pattern: ^ORCID:[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{3}[0-9X]$
  description: A human curator is identified by an ORCID.

docs.title: Enum: ParkinsonianDisorderEnum
docs.text: Parkinson disease and the atypical parkinsonian disorders it is most often distinguished from. MONDO files multiple system atrophy and Lewy body dementia under synucleinopathy, and progressive supranuclear palsy under movement disorder, rather than under parkinsonian disorder, so each is listed as its own root.

    range: float
    required: true
  id:
    name: id

    from_schema: https://w3id.org/pd-biomarker-model
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:identifier
    identifier: true
    owner: ParkinsonsClinicalAssessment
    domain_of:
    - NamedThing
    range: uriorcurie
    required: true
    pattern: ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$
rules:
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      instrument:
        name: instrument
        equals_string: MDS_UPDRS_PART_I
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      score:
        name: score
        minimum_value: 0
        maximum_value: 52
  description: MDS-UPDRS Part I total ranges from 0 to 52.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      instrument:
        name: instrument
        equals_string: MDS_UPDRS_PART_II
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      score:
        name: score
        minimum_value: 0
        maximum_value: 52
  description: MDS-UPDRS Part II total ranges from 0 to 52.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      instrument:
        name: instrument
        equals_string: MDS_UPDRS_PART_III
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      score:
        name: score
        minimum_value: 0
        maximum_value: 132
  description: MDS-UPDRS Part III total ranges from 0 to 132.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      instrument:
        name: instrument
        equals_string: MDS_UPDRS_PART_IV
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      score:
        name: score
        minimum_value: 0
        maximum_value: 24
  description: MDS-UPDRS Part IV total ranges from 0 to 24.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      instrument:
        name: instrument
        equals_string: HOEHN_YAHR
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      score:
        name: score
        minimum_value: 0
        maximum_value: 5
  description: Hoehn and Yahr stage ranges from 0 to 5.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      instrument:
        name: instrument
        equals_string: MOCA
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      score:
        name: score
        minimum_value: 0
        maximum_value: 30
  description: MoCA total ranges from 0 to 30.
- preconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      instrument:
        name: instrument
        equals_string_in:
        - MDS_UPDRS_PART_III
        - HOEHN_YAHR
  postconditions:
    slot_conditions:
      medication_state:
        name: medication_state
        required: true
  description: Motor examination scores depend on medication, so MDS-UPDRS Part III
    and Hoehn and Yahr need the medication state.
